column1: Welcome to the land of Aurindel, a land of blades and sorcery. At the moment it is a conflict. The princess, on her way to a covenant, was kidnapped by the Dragoon and taken to his man-cave. You, a lowly squire, task it upon yourself to save her from the great shut-in. You will face challenges, dangerous enemies, confounding puzzles, and new friends along the way. Do you have what it takes to find the Holy Grail?...er-Save the princess. Find out right now!\n
